steps: Step 1: The ray meets the top face; draw the normal where it enters.
Step 2: In the glass the ray slows down and bends towards the normal.
Step 3: Leaving the glass it speeds up, bends away from the normal and comes out parallel to the incident ray.
alt.summary: A ray of light enters a rectangular glass block, bends towards the normal inside the glass, then bends away from the normal as it leaves, emerging parallel to the incident ray.

entry.alt_text: A ray of light enters a rectangular glass block, bends towards the normal inside the glass, then bends away from the normal as it leaves, emerging parallel to the incident ray.
entry.attribution: Our own drawing, made for Jana with AI assistance.

parts.function: A rectangular block of glass with parallel faces.
parts.name: Glass block

parts.function: The ray of light in air travelling towards the block.
parts.name: Incident ray

parts.function: A line at right angles to the surface where the ray goes into the glass.
parts.name: Normal where the ray enters

parts.function: The angle between the incident ray and the normal, in air.
parts.name: Angle of incidence

parts.function: The ray inside the glass; it bends towards the normal because light slows down in glass.
parts.name: Refracted ray

parts.function: The angle between the refracted ray and the normal, in glass; it is smaller than the angle of incidence.
parts.name: Angle of refraction

parts.function: A line at right angles to the surface where the ray comes out of the glass.
parts.name: Normal where the ray leaves

parts.function: The ray back in air; it bends away from the normal and runs parallel to the incident ray.
parts.name: Emergent ray

steps.caption: The ray meets the top face; draw the normal where it enters.
In the glass the ray slows down and bends towards the normal.
Leaving the glass it speeds up, bends away from the normal and comes out parallel to the incident ray.

sequences.title: A ray passing through the block
